q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an electricity meter?
title: Electricity meter carbon footprint per meter
short: Add the circuit board, current sensor, display, relay and plastic case per meter with supplier figures. Add assembly, calibration and testing electricity, then divide by meters passed. Smart meters add a communication module.

ul: Current transformer or shunt, relay and display.
Plastic base and cover, terminal block.

p: Report per meter by type, single or three phase, and with or without a communication module.

example.title: Worked example: electricity meter unit per meter (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 50,000 = 0.284 kg CO2 per meter
Add board, sensor and case for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
